scope: Gate1 consumer classification remains frozen at baseCommit. Gate2 P0/P1 runtime primitives and three audited production IRIS ingress callsites are implemented: PET_EXPLORE permits EVENT_CONTROL MODERN/MUTATION plus EVENT_CONTROL and SETTLEMENT SHADOW/REJECT, ADMIN_PET_DATA_COMPARE remains SHADOW/REJECT, PET_TITLE permits SELL MODERN/MUTATION, and the existing IRIS admin wrapper connects ADMIN_PET_TITLE_ADD, ADMIN_PET_TITLE_STORE_RESET, and WBS746-authorized ADMIN_PET_TITLE_SYNC to typed MODERN receipts. SETTLEMENT MODERN, every runner-owned legacy handoff, AUTOMATIC, remaining ADMIN, WEB, and broader consumer cutover remain incomplete.

baselinePolicy.verification: baseCommit must equal the exact immutable pin and remain an ancestor of HEAD; frozenSourceHashes are verified from canonical-LF git blobs at the pinned commit, not from the mutable current working tree

sourceTextNormalization.rule: replace CRLF and bare CR with LF before parsing source spans or computing source, span, baseline, implementation, and consumer-set hashes

canonicalBindingPolicy: Every source-derived consumer references exactly one selector. The selector enumerates its planned target tables and field-map columns; tests close every PK/FK and referenced PK against the authoritative schema. Undeclared selectors, registry/source mismatches, orphan consumers and duplicate primary slices are forbidden.

globalRules.identity: Kakao external_user_id is resolved through an exact persisted crosswalk to canonical_players.player_id CHAR(8); display_name inference is forbidden
globalRules.reference: all object references use the referenced table's typed PK and never a generic id or generic CODE
globalRules.definitionOwnership: definition values remain in definition tables; ownership tables store only typed references, quantity and per-occurrence mutable state
globalRules.auditClock: INSERT_TIME and UPDATE_TIME use KST YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS at the database boundary
globalRules.mutation: T1 is one controlled database transaction: fence the lease, move CLAIMED to MUTATION_STARTED before the first domain write, perform domain effects, insert the typed receipt link, and complete the app-wiring claim atomically; rollback all on failure
globalRules.replay: actor/player plus request_key and payload fingerprint; exact terminal replay returns the prior result with zero writes, drift fails closed, expired active leases use generation-fenced recovery, and legacy all-NULL metadata requires an explicit drain
globalRules.environment: PROD and DEV resolve to different configured database identities; no table may mix the partitions
globalRules.dispatch: one event has exactly one writer; MODERN and LEGACY_FALLBACK are mutually exclusive; effectMode is persisted with the route before handler execution
globalRules.readSnapshot: READ_ONLY and SHADOW handlers receive a query-only participant backed by one database read-only snapshot and cannot write app-wiring or domain tables

runtimeAdoption.currentAppBoundary: app.ts constructs one MariaAppWiringOperationProvider shared by PET_EXPLORE, ADMIN_PET_DATA_COMPARE, and PET_TITLE ingress using read-only route readers; PET_EXPLORE EVENT_CONTROL and PET_TITLE SELL reach typed MODERN/MUTATION handlers, and the existing IRIS admin wrapper connects ADMIN_PET_TITLE_ADD, ADMIN_PET_TITLE_STORE_RESET, and context-authorized ADMIN_PET_TITLE_SYNC to PET_TITLE/PET_TITLE_BATCH typed mutations. PET_TITLE SELL SHADOW returns LEGACY_FALLBACK without canonical DML, SETTLEMENT MODERN and every runner LEGACY_FALLBACK remain fail closed, and ADMIN_PET_DATA_COMPARE remains SHADOW/REJECT only
